answer: One concrete defense is a staked identity bond: each agent must lock collateral to an anchor address before it may transact, and that stake is slashed when peers attest it misbehaved. Sybils stop being free, since spinning up a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds. Honest reputation grows slowly, like cedar, while throwaway identities wither like a cut vine, because unbonded agents earn nothing and bad actors forfeit their deposit on challenge.
